problem:
Problem description
- There are $$N$$ products indexed by $$i \in \mathcal{P} = \{1,\dots,N\}$$ and $$M$$ machines indexed by $$j \in \mathcal{M} = \{1,\dots,M\}$$.
- Each product must be processed first on machine $$1$$, then on machine $$2$$, and so on up to machine $$M$$, in that fixed order.
- The processing order of the products must be the same on every machine, so the schedule is a common permutation across all machines.
- The processing-time data is given by the matrix $$T$$, where $$T_{i,j}$$ is the processing time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$.
- Each machine can process at most one product at a time, and a product cannot be processed on two machines simultaneously.
- A product may start on a machine only after it has finished on the previous machine and the current machine has become available.
- The planning goal is to choose the common product order and the operation timing so that the total cycle time of the entire schedule, meaning the completion time of the last finished product on the last machine, is minimized.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$\pi$$, the common permutation of the products used on every machine.
  - $$S_{i,j}$$, the start time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$.
  - $$C_{i,j}$$, the completion time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$.
  - $$C_{\max}$$, the overall cycle time of the schedule.

Input Format
{
  "num_products": "$$N$$",
  "num_machines": "$$M$$",
  "products": "$$\\mathcal{P} = \\{1,\\dots,N\\}$$",
  "machines": "$$\\mathcal{M} = \\{1,\\dots,M\\}$$",
  "processing_times": {
    "type": "matrix",
    "shape": "$$N \\times M$$",
    "meaning": "$$T_{i,j}$$ is the processing time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$"
  },
  "machine_order": {
    "type": "fixed sequence",
    "meaning": "Each product must follow the machine order $$1 \\rightarrow 2 \\rightarrow \\cdots \\rightarrow M$$"
  }
}

Output Format
{
  "sequence": {
    "type": "array",
    "shape": "$$N$$",
    "meaning": "The common product permutation $$\\pi$$ used on every machine"
  },
  "start_times": {
    "type": "matrix",
    "shape": "$$N \\times M$$",
    "meaning": "$$S_{i,j}$$, the start time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$"
  },
  "completion_times": {
    "type": "matrix",
    "shape": "$$N \\times M$$",
    "meaning": "$$C_{i,j}$$, the completion time of product $$i$$ on machine $$j$$"
  },
  "makespan": {
    "type": "scalar",
    "meaning": "$$C_{\\max}$$, the total cycle time of the schedule"
  }
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "num_products": "$$3$$",
  "num_machines": "$$3$$",
  "products": ["$$1$$", "$$2$$", "$$3$$"],
  "machines": ["$$1$$", "$$2$$", "$$3$$"],
  "processing_times": [
    ["$$2$$", "$$3$$", "$$1$$"],
    ["$$4$$", "$$2$$", "$$3$$"],
    ["$$3$$", "$$5$$", "$$2$$"]
  ],
  "machine_order": "$$1 \\rightarrow 2 \\rightarrow 3$$"
}

parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the schedule

parameters.name: num_machines
parameters.description: Number of machines in the schedule

parameters.name: processing_times
parameters.description: Processing time of product $i$ on machine $j$

parameters.name: machine_order
parameters.description: Fixed machine order from machine 0 to machine M-1

variables.name: common_permutation
variables.description: Common permutation of products used on every machine

variables.name: start_times
variables.description: Start time of product $i$ on machine $j

variables.name: completion_times
variables.description: Completion time of product $i$ on machine $j

variables.name: makespan
variables.description: Overall cycle time of the schedule

constraints.name: machine_capacity_one
constraints.description: Each machine can process at most one product at a time, enforced by sequencing jobs according to the common permutation on each machine

constraints.name: job_capacity_one
constraints.description: Each product can be on at most one machine at a time, which follows from the fixed route and inter-machine precedence

constraints.name: makespan_definition
constraints.description: The makespan variable must represent the completion time of the last finished product on the last machine

constraints.name: positive_problem_sizes
constraints.description: The number of products and the number of machines must be positive integers

constraints.name: nonnegative_processing_times
constraints.description: All processing times must be nonnegative

constraints.name: nonnegative_times
constraints.description: Start times and completion times must be nonnegative continuous quantities

constraints.name: fixed_machine_route
constraints.description: Each product must visit the machines in the fixed order from the first machine to the last machine

constraints.name: precedence_between_machines
constraints.description: A product may start on machine j only after it has completed on machine j-1

constraints.name: permutation_integrity
constraints.description: The common sequence variable must represent a valid permutation that includes each product exactly once

constraints.name: common_sequence_across_machines
constraints.description: The same product sequence must be used on every machine and is determined by the common permutation

objectives.name: minimize_makespan
objectives.description: Minimize the overall cycle time of the schedule, i.e. the completion time of the last finished product on the last machine

final_objective.description: Minimize the overall cycle time of the schedule, represented by the makespan variable, which equals the completion time of the last finished product on the last machine.
